description: This Java source file defines a utility class ApiVersionUtil for parsing, serializing, sanitizing, and selecting preferred API versions from JSON strings, specifically for handling ApiVersion objects within the Nextcloud Notes Android client project.

classes.name: ApiVersionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing, serializing, sanitizing, and selecting API versions represented by ApiVersion objects.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to extract a collection of ApiVersion objects, ignoring invalid entries and versions with major and minor both zero.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a collection of ApiVersion objects into a JSON string representation, or returns null if the collection is null or empty.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Parses and then serializes a raw JSON string to produce a sanitized version of the API versions string.

methods.name: getPreferredApiVersion
methods.description: Determines the highest supported ApiVersion from a raw JSON string, considering only versions supported by the application.
